text: Prominent Disclosure for Location has been updated.
subpoints: Google didn't like the order my location disclosure usage was displayed in even though it's been fine for all of this year already. So this is a hotfix to correct it.

text: Fixed a Out of Memory crash.
subpoints: Rapid notifications would cause SpeakThat's in-built logger to fill its debug file, allowing it to surpass SpeakThat's maximum allowed capacity. This has now been fixed.

text: Private Mode has a new structure.
subpoints: The word 'private' has been removed from private mode speech. I realised it actually is less inconspicuous to omit it entirely, but feedback is welcome on ths.

text: The following changes are from SpeakThat! v1.9.1.
subpoints: I'm doing it this way as most people on the Google Play Store won't be on the latest version. So a hotfix is required.

text: Default Content Type updated to Music.
subpoints: Content Type has been set to Music by default as per GitHub issues 151 and 152. Music makes the most sense for this type of audio.

text: Conditional Rules has a couple of new features!
subpoints: Override Audio Stream has been added, allowing the stream type to be dynamically changed based on your notification.
Word Swap has also been added. This works the same way as the one in Filter Settings, but can now be applied on a per-notification basis.

text: Grouped notifications may be read more consistently now.
subpoints: SpeakThat uses a few new tricks to work out what the new notification is, and filter out the existing ones.

text: Added the option to hide filtered notifications from the history.
subpoints: Helpful if you filter an awful lot of notifications!

text: Override Content Cap (Conditional Rules) now works more reliably.
subpoints: I realised some of its logic wasn't actually hooked up properly. Serves me right for vibecoding.

text: Fixed an issue with Private Mode.
subpoints: Private Mode now works correctly if your speech template doesn't use the Content placeholder.
Fixed a time-of-check to time-of-use race condition between SpeakThat and your TTS engine when both tried to tear the speech down at the same time.
Fixed a crash when SpeakThat was unable to release the speech WakeLock, which now has a try/catch block.
Fixed a crash when earcons being attempted on Android versions that weren't able to support its methods.
